correctness.rationale: At A=diag(−1,0,1,2), w=cos εe2+sin εe4, u=−sin εe2+cos εe4 and W=[w,e3], A w=d w+b u with d=2sin² ε, b=sin 2ε; W*AW=diag(d,1). For the square Gaussian sketch G=Omega*W and h=Omega*u the reduced matrix is triangular with selected near-zero eigenvalue d+b(G−1h)_1. The nullspace of Gaussian [G,−h] is projective Haar, so G−1h has ratios of three independent standard circular complex Gaussians. The selected eigenvector z=−bZ2/((1−d)Z0−bZ1); (1−d)²+b²=1 makes the denominator independent standard Gaussian. Hence R=tX/(Y+tX), exact CDF x/(t+(1−t)x), F1/F2 moments, asymptotic mean 8ε²log(1/ε) and RMS 2ε. Independently integrated the exact moment density at t=0.16 to high precision. Claims concern specified branch and exact arithmetic only, not all selectors.
